editor.title: Function editor
editor.intro.global: Global functions: every site answers with these after its own functions. [Back to global functions](backUrl)
editor.hint.check: **Check** compiles the files as a deploy would, without going live, so you can test them below.
editor.hint.deploySite: **Deploy** compiles them again and makes them the live functions.
editor.hint.deploySiteReplacing: **Deploy** compiles them again and makes them the live functions, in place of {label}.
editor.hint.deployGlobal: **Deploy** compiles them again and makes them the live functions of every site.
editor.hint.deployGlobalReplacing: **Deploy** compiles them again and makes them the live functions of every site, in place of {label}.
editor.test.title: Test
editor.test.hint: Runs one request in memory, with your real code and the site's real data, so anything it writes or sends really happens. The build's middleware runs first, so if a gate refuses the request, add what it needs, such as a cookie or a token, in **Headers**.
